key_highlights: ASX registers a third consecutive week of gains powered by rallies across mining and technology sectors (^AXJO).
Australian unemployment surges to a five-year high, depressing the AUD/USD and sharply paring RBA rate hike expectations.
Residential property faces acute headwinds as Sydney auction clearance rates slump amid rising mortgage stress.
Resource juniors face divergent fortunes: gold and critical minerals exploration accelerates, while junior Pilbara iron ore producers face margin squeeze.

sectors.trend: Strong momentum in gold and critical minerals exploration offset by structural margin compression for junior iron ore miners.
sectors.implications: Favours tier-1 low-cost producers (BHP.AX, RIO.AX) and developing gold plays over high-cost junior iron ore operators.

sectors.trend: Labor market deterioration softens rate outlook but intensifies credit risk across residential mortgage books.
sectors.implications: Net interest margins face headwinds; rising auction failures and arrears risk pressure major bank valuations (CBA.AX, WBC.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX).

sectors.trend: East coast domestic gas market turmoil and supply friction escalate volatility.
sectors.implications: Supports realized domestic gas pricing for uncontracted producers (WDS.AX, STO.AX) while increasing operating input costs for domestic manufacturers.

sectors.trend: Tech equities rally alongside global peers, supported by data centre infrastructure expansion.
sectors.implications: Defensive growth and digital infrastructure assets (NEXTDC, Goodman Group) gain institutional support.

sectors.trend: Consumer spending constrained by rising unemployment and discretionary headwinds; corporate governance scrutiny increases.
sectors.implications: Headwinds for discretionary retailers (SUL.AX) and domestic travel capacity (Carnival fleet cut).

sectors.trend: Sydney auction downturn deepens and home values face accelerated contraction.
sectors.implications: Downside risks for residential developers and mortgage-exposed REITs; potential cap-rate relief if RBA cuts materialize.

key_themes: Labor market loosening easing RBA tightening pressure while stoking credit risk concerns.
Resource sector bifurcating between gold/critical minerals momentum and junior bulk commodity headwinds.
Housing market correction accelerating in metropolitan auction markets.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Accelerating Housing Market Downturn & Mortgage Arrears
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight high-LVR mortgage-concentrated lenders; favour well-capitalised banks and diversified financials.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Labor Market Weakness & Domestic Demand Contraction
risk_assessment.mitigation: Pivot portfolio weightings toward defensive healthcare, staples, and export-oriented USD-earners.
Limit exposure to high-cost junior bulk miners; maintain exposure to low-cost tier-1 producers (BHP.AX, RIO.AX).
Focus on balance-sheet strength, cash generation, and pricing power rather than highly leveraged growth equities.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight Tier-1 Diversified Miners and Gold Producers
opportunities.rationale: Strong balance sheets, robust gold exploration momentum, and low cost curves protect margins against macro headwinds.

opportunities.recommendation: Selective Allocation to Data Infrastructure and Tech Leaders
opportunities.rationale: Structural demand for cloud and AI infrastructure continues to drive outperformance despite macro softness.

opportunities.recommendation: Capitalise on AUD Depreciation via USD Revenue Earners
opportunities.rationale: Jobless shock weighs on AUD/USD, providing organic FX earnings translation tailwinds for global earners.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce Exposure to High-Cost Junior Iron Ore Explorers
defensive_moves.rationale: Price vulnerability and margin squeezes present heightened cash-burn and balance-sheet risk.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim Domestic Discretionary Retail and High-LVR Bank Exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Deteriorating housing auctions and five-year high unemployment heighten loan loss provisioning and crimp consumer spend.

market_outlook.short_term: Consolidation likely for the ASX 200 (^AXJO) following three weeks of gains as macro headwinds from weakening employment and housing stress temper resource sector strength.
market_outlook.long_term: Resilient resource exports and eventual RBA policy easing should support large caps (BHP.AX, CSL.AX), though domestic financial and consumer sectors will require extended recovery cycles.
key_catalysts: Subsequent ABS employment print and quarterly CPI releases.
Upcoming RBA monetary policy statement and rate trajectory guidance.
Auction clearance rates and residential price trend validation from CoreLogic/SQM.
Chinese industrial production data and steel mill operating margins.
watch_list: AUD/USD currency level following the employment release.
Dalian and Singapore iron ore futures benchmarks.
Mortgage arrears rates across major commercial bank reporting.
